points.K1: 生物安全：降低接触微生物的风险
points.K3: 两大原则：防护和风险评估
points.K6: 生物安全、生物安保、生物危害
points.K8: 风险有高低，评估是基石
points.K10: 第二步：谁会受害，怎么受害
points.K11: 第三步：评估风险，定好措施
points.K13: 第五步：定期复查，及时更新
points.S1: 实验服、手套不出实验室
points.S2: 评估也看化学和物理危害
points.S3: 剩余风险可接受，才开工

shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a microbiology teaching lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到生物安全第一课。
overlay: 生物安全第一课：防护与风险评估

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现盾牌和放大镜两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to two floating icons: a shield and a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 今天讲两件事：防护和风险评估。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进微生物实验室，好奇地看着培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters a microbiology lab for the first time and looks curiously at a stack of culture dishes with blank labels.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次走进微生物实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手想直接拿培养皿，小研抬手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches for a culture dish with bare hands; the female graduate student raises a hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 他伸手就去拿培养皿。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰空白实验服和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a lab coat and a box of gloves with a blank label.
shots.narration: 小研说：先弄懂什么叫生物安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们从一个定义说起。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：降低接触微生物的风险
shots.scene: 实验台上放着几个培养皿，周围飘着微小的点
shots.prompt_en: Culture dishes on a lab bench with tiny floating dots around them, a small biohazard warning sign nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物看不见，却可能有感染性。
overlay: 生物安全：降低接触微生物的风险

shots.section_title: 生物安全：降低接触微生物的风险
shots.scene: 穿实验服、戴手套和护目镜的人形图标，外面一圈防护罩
shots.prompt_en: A person outline wearing a lab coat, gloves and goggles, surrounded by a soft protective bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全，就是一整套防护措施，

shots.section_title: 生物安全：降低接触微生物的风险
shots.scene: 小研戴好手套，在安全柜里操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles and gloves, works calmly inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 让做实验的人少接触、不感染。

shots.scene: 微小的点从实验台扩散到整个房间的示意图被拦住
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a lab room: dots spreading from a bench are stopped by a barrier line before reaching the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 它还要防止污染工作环境，

shots.scene: 实验楼外的街道和住宅区图标，上面有绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab building beside a street and houses, with a green check mark above them. No people.
shots.narration: 最终保护的是我们身边的社区。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着三层同心圆：人、实验室、社区
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three concentric circles: a person icon in the center, a lab icon, then a town icon outside.
shots.narration: 保护自己，保护实验室，保护大家。

shots.section_title: 两大原则：防护和风险评估
shots.scene: 一个大标题框分出两个箭头，指向盾牌和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: one large blank box with two arrows pointing down to a shield icon and a magnifying glass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全有两大原则。
overlay: 两大原则：防护和风险评估

shots.section_title: 两大原则：防护和风险评估
shots.scene: 盾牌和放大镜并排亮起
shots.prompt_en: The shield icon and the magnifying glass icon light up side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 一个是防护，一个是风险评估。

shots.scene: 五个图标围成一圈：书本、手、清单、楼房、柜子
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a ring: an open book, a gloved hand, a checklist, a building, and a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 防护不是一样东西，而是一整套，

shots.scene: 王老师翻开空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank standard operating procedure binder on a desk.
shots.narration: 有方法、规范和程序，

shots.scene: 老李检查实验室门、通风口和生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a lab door, an air vent and a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 也有设施和设备。

shots.scene: 生物危害材料放在密闭容器里
shots.prompt_en: A sealed container with a biohazard warning sign on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 用它们来管好有生物危害的材料。

shots.scene: 盾牌挡住飞向人形图标的点
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon blocks tiny dots flying toward a person outline. No people.
shots.narration: 防护的目的，是减少暴露。

shots.scene: 盾牌挡住飞向树木和河流图标的点
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon blocks tiny dots drifting toward tree and river icons. No people.
shots.narration: 人不暴露，环境也不暴露。

shots.scene: 一个“暴露”刻度从高降到零
shots.prompt_en: A simple dial with a needle moving from high down to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 能消除就消除，不能就尽量减少。

shots.section_title: 生物安全、生物安保、生物危害
shots.scene: 三个咬合的齿轮：绿色、红色、黄色
shots.prompt_en: Three interlocking gears in green, red and yellow turning together. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全常和两个词放在一起。
overlay: 生物安全、生物安保、生物危害

shots.section_title: 生物安全、生物安保、生物危害
shots.scene: 黄色齿轮上是生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The yellow gear shows a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 生物危害，是可能伤人的生物因子。

shots.section_title: 生物安全、生物安保、生物危害
shots.scene: 红色齿轮上是锁头图标
shots.prompt_en: The red gear shows a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保，是防止它被丢失、被盗。

shots.section_title: 生物安全、生物安保、生物危害
shots.scene: 三个齿轮一起转动
shots.prompt_en: All three gears turn smoothly together. No people.
shots.narration: 三者互相咬合，一个也不能少。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着一支样品管
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a sample tube with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估，是一个评价的过程。

shots.scene: 天平两端：一端是骰子，一端是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a dice icon on one side and a warning triangle icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 看出事的可能性有多大，

shots.scene: 警示三角越变越大
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon grows larger step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 后果有多严重。

shots.scene: 问号云朵飘在样品管上方
shots.prompt_en: A cloud with a question mark floats above a sample tube. No people.
shots.narration: 还要看清有哪些不确定的地方。

shots.section_title: 风险有高低，评估是基石
shots.scene: 仪表盘从低到高，指针在中间摆动
shots.prompt_en: A gauge dial from green low to red high, with the needle swinging in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 风险有高有低，要先评估再动手。
overlay: 风险有高低，评估是基石

shots.section_title: 风险有高低，评估是基石
shots.scene: 一座房子的地基被标亮
shots.prompt_en: A house icon whose foundation layer glows. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估，是生物安全的地基。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着五个台阶的空白图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank chart showing five steps like a staircase.
shots.narration: 风险评估一般分五步。

shots.scene: 小研对着样品清单逐项查看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank sample list item by item at her desk.
shots.narration: 第一步，找出危害：用的是什么，

shots.scene: 离心、涡旋、注射器的图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a centrifuge, a vortex mixer and a syringe. No people.
shots.narration: 要做哪些操作，会不会溅、会不会扎。

shots.section_title: 第二步：谁会受害，怎么受害
shots.scene: 几个人形图标：操作者、旁边的同学、清洁工
shots.prompt_en: Several person outlines: the operator at a bench, a nearby student, and a cleaner with a cart. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，想清楚谁可能受害。
overlay: 第二步：谁会受害，怎么受害

shots.section_title: 第二步：谁会受害，怎么受害
shots.scene: 吸入、皮肤、针刺、入口四个途径图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons of exposure routes: breathing air, a skin splash, a needle prick, and a hand near the mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 是吸进去、溅到、扎到还是吃进去。

shots.section_title: 第三步：评估风险，定好措施
shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白风险评估表讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student discuss a blank risk assessment form at a table.
shots.narration: 第三步，评估风险，决定措施。
overlay: 第三步：评估风险，定好措施

shots.section_title: 第三步：评估风险，定好措施
shots.scene: 安全柜、手套护目镜、利器盒三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biological safety cabinet, gloves with goggles, and a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 用什么设备，穿什么防护，怎么操作。

shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 第四步，把评估结果写下来，

shots.scene: 阿杰按清单穿戴好实验服、手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a lab coat, gloves and goggles following a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 然后真正落实到每次操作。

shots.section_title: 第五步：定期复查，及时更新
shots.scene: 日历翻页，评估表上画着循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flips pages next to a blank risk assessment form with a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第五步，定期复查评估。
overlay: 第五步：定期复查，及时更新

shots.section_title: 第五步：定期复查，及时更新
shots.scene: 老周在评估表上修改并标出新版本
shots.prompt_en: The older man updates a blank risk assessment form and stamps it with a new version mark.
shots.narration: 换了材料、方法或人，就要更新。

shots.section_title: 实验服、手套不出实验室
shots.scene: 穿实验服、戴手套的人形图标走向门外，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person outline in a lab coat and gloves walking out a lab door toward a hallway, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 保护社区，从小事做起。
overlay: 实验服、手套不出实验室

shots.section_title: 实验服、手套不出实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰在门口挂好实验服、摘下手套丢进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: At the lab exit, the young male student hangs his lab coat on a hook and drops his gloves into a waste bin with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 离开前，脱实验服、摘手套，

shots.section_title: 实验服、手套不出实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰在水池前认真洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands carefully with soap at a sink by the lab door.
shots.narration: 认真洗手，再走出实验室。

shots.section_title: 评估也看化学和物理危害
shots.scene: 评估表旁边出现消毒剂瓶、锐器和高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form surrounded by icons of a disinfectant bottle, a sharp blade and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估别只盯着微生物。
overlay: 评估也看化学和物理危害

shots.section_title: 评估也看化学和物理危害
shots.scene: 消毒剂瓶上有腐蚀和刺激的象形图
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle with corrosion and exclamation hazard pictograms on a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒剂、固定液也有化学危害，

shots.section_title: 评估也看化学和物理危害
shots.scene: 锐器、高温高压、紫外灯三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a needle, a steaming autoclave and an ultraviolet lamp, each with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器、高温、紫外灯也会伤人。

shots.section_title: 剩余风险可接受，才开工
shots.scene: 天平一端是风险，一端是措施，逐渐平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a warning triangle on one side and a shield on the other, slowly coming level. No people.
shots.narration: 措施定好后，再看剩下的风险。
overlay: 剩余风险可接受，才开工

shots.section_title: 剩余风险可接受，才开工
shots.scene: 老周看着评估表，点头签批
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews the blank risk assessment form, nods and signs it.
shots.narration: 能接受，负责人批准后才开工。

shots.section_title: 剩余风险可接受，才开工
shots.scene: 仪表盘仍指向红区，旁边的暂停手势
shots.prompt_en: A gauge needle still in the red zone, next to a stop hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还太高，就加措施或者不做。

shots.section_title: 剩余风险可接受，才开工
shots.scene: 阿杰举手问小研问题
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the female graduate student a question.
shots.narration: 学生不确定，先问导师，不擅自做。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现盾牌和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating shield and magnifying glass icons.
shots.narration: 生物安全：护人、护环境、护社区。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标依次点亮
shots.prompt_en: A five-step staircase icon lights up step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 找危害、看谁受害、定措施、记录落实、复查。

shots.scene: 实验服挂钩、洗手、化学瓶、仪表盘四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a lab coat on a hook, washing hands, a chemical bottle, and a gauge in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 防护不出门，危害看全，风险可控再做。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰穿好防护站在实验室里挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student, now in lab coat, gloves and goggles, wave goodbye in the lab.
shots.narration: 先评估，再动手，下次见！
